description: Hermetic QwenProxy↔chat-daily error contract. Codes must match qwenproxy ERROR_CODES where proxy-originated; client-local 200 soft failures listed separately.

codes.notes: Missing/wrong Authorization; client must not retry
Display names / non-slug model ids rejected by proxy
Upstream RateLimited; proxy may attach Retry-After; client caps wait at 60s
All account lanes busy; Retry-After typically 2s
Browser/upstream 200 with empty non-stream body after internal retry
Headers path timed out; do not leak account id
Session missing or chat input unavailable
No healthy accounts (cooldown or no state)
Client-local: 200 with empty or whitespace-only message.content
